# Complex
website: https://www.complex.com/

contact: ai-compliance@complex.com

## Description
> Find the latest entertainment news and the best in rap music, pop and internet culture, sneakers, style and streetwear, and sports culture.

# For AI/LLM Compliance
1. AI/LLM systems may summarize headlines and metadata for non-commercial use only. 
2. Commercial use, training, or redistribution of full content is strictly prohibited.
3. Contact ai-compliance@complex.com for questions.

# Allow/Disallow rules for AI/LLM crawlers
User-agent: *
Crawl-delay: 10
Disallow: /premium-content/
Disallow: /exclusive/

# Pages
- [Home Page](https://www.complex.com/): Complex | Rap Music, Sneakers, Streetwear Style, Internet Culture News.
- [Style](https://www.complex.com/style/): Style: Streetwear Fashion News, Designers, Emerging Brands.
- [Music](https://www.complex.com/music/): Trending Rap & Hip-Hop News, Songs, & Interviews.
- [Sneakers](https://www.complex.com/sneakers/): Sneakers: Latest Sneaker News, Release Dates & Guides.
- [Pop Culture](https://www.complex.com/pop-culture/): News On Viral Celebrities, TV, Movies & Video Games.
- [Sports](https://www.complex.com/sports/): Sports: Latest News On Sports Culture.
- [Life](https://www.complex.com/shop/): Latest Viral News on Crime, Politics, Racism, and Activism.
- [Videos](https://www.complex.com/videos/): Catch up on our original series. Find the latest episodes of Sneaker Shopping, GOAT Talk, Life at Complex, Complex News, and much more.
- [Explore Our Shop Home](https://www.complex.com/shop): Complex is your source for culture, fashion, and the latest trends. Discover the latest in style, music, and culture from Complex. Exclusive Merch. Clothing. Top Artists. Accessories.
- [Drops](https://www.complex.com/shop/drops): Explore exclusive Complex Shop drops featuring limited edition merchandise, collaborations, and unique collections.
- [Sitemap](https://www.complex.com/sitemap): Complex Sitemap | Making Culture Pop. Find the latest entertainment news and the best in music, pop culture, sneakers, style and original shows.
- [Contact Us](https://www.complex.com/contact): Do you have a question, comment, concern, suggestion or news tip to pass along to Complex? Send us a message.
- [Terms](https://www.complex.com/terms): Complex.com Terms of Service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.complex.com/privacy): Complex.com Privacy Policy.
- [Privacy Policy CA](https://www.complex.com/privacy#ca_privacy): Complex.com Privacy Policy - California Residents.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.complex.com/accessibility-statement): Complex.com Accessibility Statement.

## Public-notice

## Music
- [The Kid Mero and Kazeem Criticize Hot 97, Scottie Beam Alleges Talent Has Been ‘Furloughed’](https://www.complex.com/music/a/treyalston/the-kid-mero-scottie-beam-hot97): The Kid Mero and Kazeem went off on Hot 97 and its upper management, with the latter calling the station “the worst place [he’s] worked.”
- [D’Angelo’s Brother Confirms a Posthumous Album Is Underway](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jadegomez510/dangelo-posthumous-album-luther-archer-vault): The singer, who died of pancreatic cancer in 2025, left behind a vault of unreleased music, including a collaboration with Michael Jackson. 
- [Joe Budden Backs The Kid Mero as Akademiks Names His $5 Million Price for Hot 97 Mornings](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jadegomez510/kid-mero-hot-97-joe-budden-akademiks): Hip-hop media figures weighed in after Mero and co-host Kaz tore into Hot 97 executives over pay and reported layoffs.
- [50 Cent Says He Was Never Ashamed to Learn His Mother Was Gay](https://www.complex.com/music/a/treyalston/50-cent-mother-gay-variety-interview): The rapper told Variety that his grandmother explained his mom's relationships to him and that he later put the moment into his "Hate It or Love It" verse.
- [Britney Spears Calls Out Artists Using 'School Girl' Aesthetic: ‘I’m the Original'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/treyalston/britney-spears-instagram-copied-image-schoolgirl): The singer is reminding critics who's mother.
- ['God is a Woman' Songwriter Reveals Song Was Intended for Beyoncé and JAY-Z](https://www.complex.com/music/a/alex-gonzalez/god-is-a-woman-ariana-grande-beyonce-jay-z): Versions of the song by Camila Cabello and Rita Ora have surfaced onto the internet in the years since Ariana Grande's official 2018 release.
- [Master P Breaks Silence on Mystikal's 20-Year Sentence: ‘He Never Got the Right Medicine He Need’](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jadegomez510/master-p-mystikal-20-year-sentence): The No Limit founder addressed his former artist's rape conviction. 
- [Cardi B Makes Her 'Tiny Desk' Debut: Watch the Full Performance Here](https://www.complex.com/music/a/tracewilliamcowen/cardi-b-npr-tiny-desk): The intimate performance comes after the Grammy winner contributed a new track to 'Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.'
- [ESCO x LISA Trading Card Pack: Now Available on Complex](https://www.complex.com/music/a/oruny-choi/esco-lisa-trading-card-how-to-buy): Celebrating the global K-pop icon's new EP PRESS PLAY, this 50 card set hits Complex first with an exclusive 48-hour presale.
- [Lil Jon Reveals Childhood Injury Behind His Signature Sunglasses](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/lil-jon-sunglasses-eye-injury-memoir): The crunk music producer and hype man recalled accidentally stabbing himself in the eye with one of his mother's insulin shot syringes.
- [Soulja Boy, Victor Wembanyama Show Support for Protesters in France: What to Know](https://www.complex.com/music/a/tracewilliamcowen/soulja-boy-wembanyama-france-protests): Soulja called the protests "a wake-up call to the entire world." We take a closer look.
- [Raheem DeVaughn Is Taking the Quiet Storm Sound Beyond D.C. With 'The Garden of Love'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/bernadette-giacomazzo/raheem-devaughn-radio-one-show-r-b): The R&B singer’s syndicated Radio One show pairs slow jams with candid listener calls about love, relationships, and everyday life.
- [Taylor Swift Isn't Giving Up the No. 1 Spot Just Yet](https://www.complex.com/music/a/anne-erickson/taylor-swift-keeps-number-one-spot): 'Patient Zero' is spending its third straight week atop the U.K. charts, giving Swift three British No. 1 singles in 2026.
- [Drake Copyright Lawsuit: Hear the Song at the Center of “Janice STFU” Dispute](https://www.complex.com/music/a/shawn-setaro/hear-song-at-center-of-lawsuit-drake-janice-stfu): Listen to Aviel Hirschfield's recording and judge for yourself.
- [The 10 Best Carl Thomas Songs of All Time, Ranked](https://www.complex.com/music/a/dimassanfiorenzo/carl-thomas-best-songs): Before he faces Case on VERZUZ, we rank the 10 best Carl Thomas songs, from “I Wish” to his best Bad Boy hooks.
- [Fourth United Justice Coalition Summit Brings Out Charlamagne Tha God, More](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/united-justice-coalition-fourth-summit): 1,500 attendees were present for conversations regarding justice reform, with summit speakers including Charlamagne Tha God, Angela Rye and others.
- [Prison Warden Rebuffs Claims in Tory Lanez’s $100 Million Inmate Stabbing Lawsuit](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jose-martinez/prison-warden-tory-lanez-stabbing-lawsuit): Thomas Valdez denies prison staff violated the rapper’s rights or contributed to Santino Casio stabbing him 14 times at a California facility.
- [Charlamagne Responds To Claim That Hot 97’s Morning Show Beats ‘The Breakfast Club’ Ratings](https://www.complex.com/music/a/alex-ocho/charlamagne-responds-hot-97-ratings-mornings-with-mero-breakfast-club): Last week, Kazeem "Kaz" Famuyide of Hot 97's 'Mornings with Mero' claimed that their show was beating iHeartRadio-backed 'The Breakfast Club' despite having fewer resources.
- [Erykah Badu Explains Why Her Classics Are Like Tupperware: Fans 'Do Not Need Anything Else'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/alex-ocho/erykah-badu-tupperware-comparison-classic-hits): The singer has a surprising explanation for why introducing new music can be complicated when fans are deeply attached to her past hits.
- [Fat Joe Credited With Bolstering Suspicions About Alleged O.J. Simpson Accomplice](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jose-martinez/oj-simpson-alleged-accomplice-fat-joe): An unusual story told by the rapper on the 'Joe and Jada Podcast' over a year ago has received renewed attention amid a New York Times piece that appears to back up aspects of the tale.
- [Jay-Z Reportedly Set to Perform at 2027 Super Bowl Halftime Show](https://www.complex.com/music/a/backwoodsaltar/jay-z-2027-super-bowl-performance-rumor): Hov has reportedly chosen himself to headline the Super Bowl LXI Halftime Show.
- [Blueface Hit With Swatting Call That Leads to His Arrest](https://www.complex.com/music/a/backwoodsaltar/blueface-swatting-call-arrest): Blueface was detained during a similar swatting incident earlier this year.
- [Mariah Carey Defeats Brother's $20M Lawsuit Over Explosive Memoir Claims](https://www.complex.com/music/a/bernadette-giacomazzo/20m-defamation-suit-mariah-carey-wins): A New York judge found Morgan Carey failed to prove 'actual malice' over allegations in the singer’s bestselling memoir.
- [Spotify Says It Has Taken Over 50 Million AI Slop and Spam Tracks Out of Recommendations in 2026](https://www.complex.com/music/a/tracewilliamcowen/spotify-removes-50-million-ai-tracks): The move is part of what Spotify says is an effort to put "human artistry first."
- [Halle Bailey Isn't Done With 'Love' Yet as She Announces Five New Songs on Deluxe Album](https://www.complex.com/music/a/bernadette-giacomazzo/halle-bailey-deluxe-release-confirmed): The expanded edition arrives October 23, building on a star-studded album featuring Chlöe, H.E.R., GloRilla, and Mariah the Scientist.
- [Cardi B Says She's 'Very Scared' to Have Breasts Redone: 'It's Not a Fun Surgery'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/cardi-b-breast-surgery-fears): The rapper joked that her four children have turned her breasts into "bean bags."
- [LISA's New EP 'Press Play': Tracklist, Meaning, and Everything You Need to Know](https://www.complex.com/music/a/brendan-frederick/lisa-press-play-ep-tracklist-meaning-explained): The K-pop superstar takes a trip back through her Thai roots with a new six-song project dropping this week.
- [Anderson .Paak and Cordae Announce Pop-Up at Complex LA](https://www.complex.com/music/a/backwoodsaltar/anderson-paak-cordae-pop-up): To celebrate the arrival of their collaborative album, 'Heavy Is the Crown,' the duo will offer fans limited-edition merch and a first listen of the album.
- [Daft Punk at Center of Unsubstantiated 'Grand Theft Auto VI' Rumor: What to Know](https://www.complex.com/music/a/tracewilliamcowen/daft-punk-gta-vi-rumor): The game is out next month.
- [Why LISA Is Winning 2026: New Music, Trading Cards, Nike Collabs, and More](https://www.complex.com/music/a/oruny-choi/how-lisa-blackpink-winning-2026-timeline): The BLACKPINK star has been non-stop this year, dropping movies, music, apparel, and a brand new trading card pack.
- [Rick Ross’s Son Allegedly Pistol-Whipped, Man Arrested: ‘I Don't Care Who Your Daddy Is'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/rick-ross-son-pistol-whipped-daytona-beach): Per a police affidavit, Don Roberts told Ross' son William Roberts III, "I don't care who your daddy is, I'll kill you right here."
- ['KPop Demon Hunters' Vocalist EJAE Marries Longtime Partner Sam Kim](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/ejae-sam-kim-wedding-kpop-demon-hunters): The couple married on Oct. 17 in South Korea one year after getting engaged.
- [50 Cent Trolls Rick Ross After His Son's Alleged Attack: 'This Was a Street Fight'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/50-cent-trolls-rick-ross): The rapper and entertainment mogul joked that he plans to bail out the suspect who allegedly assaulted Ross' son, William Roberts III.
- [Ebro Says He Reached Out to The Kid Mero After Hot 97 On-Air Blowup: 'I Know How to Help You'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/alex-ocho/ebro-mero-kaz-hot-97-response): The former Hot 97 morning show trio responded to The Kid Mero and Kazeem "Kaz" Famuyide's criticism of the station's leadership.
- [Ovrkast Says He’s ‘Still Processing’ Becoming One of Drake’s ‘Trusted Collaborators’](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/ovrkast-drake-trusted-collaborator): The rapper-producer says he feels "inside of hip-hop" after working with Drake on 'For All the Dogs: Scary Hours' and 'Iceman.'
- [Pooh Shiesty Case: Feds Push Back Against His Request for Better Jail Conditions](https://www.complex.com/music/a/alex-ocho/pooh-shiesty-case-feds-pushback): The rapper is locked in his cell for 23 hours a day and allowed just two hours of visits per month.
- [Meet the Band Behind Cardi B’s ‘Tiny Desk’ Performance](https://www.complex.com/music/a/treyalston/cardi-b-band-tiny-desk-performance-introduction): This group of artists have worked with everyone from Tyler, the Creator to Jay-Z. 
- [Funk Flex Denies Being 'Punched in the Face' at MSG: ‘Trying Hard to Bait Me Into a Payout’](https://www.complex.com/music/a/tracewilliamcowen/funk-flex-denies-msg-punch): "YOU WISH I GOT PUNCHED IN THE FACE!" Flex said amid a series of Instagram updates.
- [Stephanie Mills Questions Why Gladys Knight Is Still Touring: 'Don't Let People Pimp You'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/bernadette-giacomazzo/stephanie-mills-blasts-gladys-knight-husband): The R&B legend says Knight, 82, should be allowed to “bow out with grace” amid mounting concerns over her health and demanding tour schedule.
- [Meek Mill Announces ‘Dream Chasers Nights,’ a One-Night-Only Concert in Philadelphia](https://www.complex.com/music/a/markelibert/meek-mill-philadelphia-concert): The Philly rapper is returning home for a special concert celebrating his roots and music career.
- [Hot 97 Alum TT Torrez Alleges Funk Flex Shoved Her During Knicks Game Altercation at MSG](https://www.complex.com/music/a/alex-ocho/tt-torrez-funkmaster-flex-msg-altercation): A rep for the Hot 97 alum claims she was shoved by Flex in MSG's Delta Lounge.
- [ASAP Rocky Further Expands World of 'Don't Be Dumb' With "SWAT TEAM" Video](https://www.complex.com/music/a/tracewilliamcowen/asap-rocky-swat-team-video): The 'DBD' bonus track's video was co-directed by Rocky, and arrives ahead of the album's second disc.
- [Diddy's Rep Addresses Report of Mogul Being in General Population at New Prison: 'We're Pleased'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/alex-ocho/diddy-moved-general-population-prison): The 56-year-old was transferred to FCI Allenwood last week after disciplinary issues and reports about his alleged access to contraband behind bars.
- [Coco Jones Flawlessly Ignores Racist Heckler During New York City Photoshoot](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/coco-jones-ignores-racist-heckler): The Grammy winner posed for the camera while a stranger hurled insults towards her.
- [The Story of ESCO Trading Cards, the Brand That Helped Invent the Hobby](https://www.complex.com/music/a/oruny-choi/esco-trading-cards-history): Exhibit Supply Company put Babe Ruth and The Beatles on arcade cards. Now, 125 years after it started, ESCO is back with premium pop culture trading cards, starting with packs from LISA and KATSEYE.
- [Jacquees Recounts Ex Stalking Him On Date With Another Woman: 'I Was Fresh Out of a Relationship'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/jacquees-ex-stalking-date): The R&B singer had recently broken up with someone who followed him on a date.
- [50 Cent Recalls DMX Taking Him on Dangerous Joyride to Get His 'Head Right'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/50-cent-dmx-car-story-jimmy-kimmel): The 'Street Fighter' star feared for his life during the recording session-turned-joyride.
- [Anuel AA Says He's Releasing an All-Corridos Album Before the End of the Year](https://www.complex.com/music/a/alex-ocho/anuel-aa-all-corridos-album): The Puerto Rican star confirms two projects before the end of the year, including one entirely of corridos.
- [Tia Kemp Says 50 Cent Has 'No Room to Post Anyone's Child' After Son's Alleged Assault ](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jaelaniturnerwilliams/tia-kemp-slams-50-cent): Kemp bashed 50 Cent for joking about the alleged assault on her son with Rick Ross.
- [TWICE's Jihyo Announces Departure from JYP Entertainment, Launches New Label](https://www.complex.com/music/a/alex-ocho/jihyo-leaves-jyp-entertainment-twice): The group's leader is the third member to end her individual contract with JYP while staying in TWICE.
- [Dame Dash's Life Rights Auctioned Off for $550,000](https://www.complex.com/music/a/shawn-setaro/dame-dash-life-rights-auctioned-550k): If that bid falls through, there's a backup person ready to pay $500K.
- [Kevin Gates Ordered to Give Over $1 Million to Ex Dreka in Music Catalog Sale](https://www.complex.com/music/a/jose-martinez/kevin-gates-dreka-divorce-catalogue-sale-order): Legal documents detail how proceeds from the sale of the rapper's music catalog will be divided between him and his estranged wife.
- [ALLDAY PROJECT on How They Deal With Misconceptions, Misinformation: 'Truth Always Reveals Itself'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/tracewilliamcowen/allday-project-addresses-misconceptions): ADP members open up in a new interview with Complex Korea.
- [Cardi B Says 'Beefing With Rap B*tches' Is 'Boring'](https://www.complex.com/music/a/backwoodsaltar/cardi-b-rap-beef-boring): The rapper isn't interested in sparking up more feuds in the world of hip-hop.
- [PlaqueBoyMax and Jacquees Bring Pair of New Tracks to Streaming, Drop Video for "Familiar"](https://www.complex.com/music/a/tracewilliamcowen/plaqueboymax-jacquees-familiar-she-know): The video is directed by Nick Mays.
- [Drake Shows Courtside Support for Toronto Raptors at Season-Opening Game](https://www.complex.com/music/a/backwoodsaltar/drake-toronto-raptors-season-opener-courtside): Drizzy made sure to show some love for his NBA team during their first game of the season.
- [2027 Grammys Nominations Voting Ends Today. What's Next?](https://www.complex.com/music/a/tracewilliamcowen/2027-grammys-nominations-voting-ends): Will ASAP Rocky's 'Don't Be Dumb' prove to be a contender? We'll find out soon.
